title: Bands' baseball teams and his love of basketball
summary: Bands had pick-up baseball games; he preferred basketball when he was a kid and finished school in 1923.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Do you know bands have baseball teams in those days.

Yeah, they in them days well they didn't call them teams -- they would just get together and play some of the guys and some afternoon when they'd meet him sometime -- you know. Oh, they wasn't called no regular team --

So some could play and some couldn't. I couldn't so I didn't. You know. Too much running is no good for me. However, when I was a kid I wanted to be a basketball player. Oh, I loved basketball. In them days. Nowadays you chase a basketball around it's a different thing -- you know -- like when I came along -- when a guy made a basket, they went back to the sign, tossed up to see who gets the ball -- they don't give it to the other side like they do here now.
And so they didn't -- the scoring wasn't as high -- like it is now.
No, that makes it a different game. When they have all that rebounding --

Yeah, but I liked it that way because -- I don't it's fair that I guy make a basket then he's got to give it to the other guy so he could make a basket. That's not fair. He should toss something and scum up with the ball. You know -- that's the way I think that's the way the game should go -- I don't care. That's the way I look at it.

Trying to make a basket and then give the other guy the ball. That's not right. I say you make it now and my turn to make it. Now it's your turn. You may do it that way. Nobody gets a chance -- I mean -- you know -- to really see how great they are -- you know.
I don't know -- when did they change those rules?
Oh, I don't know. Some time between my school days and today. My school days is way back. The last year I was in school was 1923 -- you know.
